# Top Domain Anti-Bot & Scraper Intelligence
## AI Crawler Policies (robots.txt)

- **reddit.com**: Permissive/Unknown (Flags: None)
- **nytimes.com**: Restricts AI Crawlers (Flags: gptbot, claudebot, anthropic, ccbot, applebot-extended, omgilibot)
- **wikipedia.org**: Permissive/Unknown (Flags: None)
- **github.com**: Restricts AI Crawlers (Flags: gptbot, claudebot, anthropic)
- **stackoverflow.com**: Permissive/Unknown (Flags: None)
- **news.ycombinator.com**: Permissive/Unknown (Flags: None)
- **medium.com**: Restricts AI Crawlers (Flags: gptbot, claudebot, applebot-extended)
